title: A Confession for the Inheritance Revisited
author: Orsen Dunmore
blurb: Elodie Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
